messages:
Rachel S: quick async handoff — did a rolling check on eu-west pools, rotated alerts for noisy endpoint, and left notes in the oncall doc. observed a short p50 spike on /generate around 07:12 UTC, looks correlated with small warmup traffic burst.
sre-bot: ALERT: high_latency /generate (eu-west) — 5m spike, avg p50 420ms (SLO p50=200ms). affected hosts: pool-3-0, pool-3-1. alerts triggered: 3/5.
Rachel S: Actions taken: muted the low-severity duplicate alert rule (temp), increased batching window for pool-3 to 25ms, and rolled a small config tweak to kv-cache eviction. put an entry in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-eu
Rachel S: Blockers: need a quick sanity check on the rollback plan before I leave the shift — not sure if the eviction tweak caused increased memory churn. cc @Omar M
Omar M: saw the notes — can look in ~15m. do we have logs showing heap growth? ptrace snapshot would help.
Rachel S: minimal heap bump on pool-3-1, nothing catastrophic. logs excerpt:
```
[07:11:58] pool-3-1 kv-cache: hit_rate=0.82 mem_rss=3.1GB
[07:12:02] pool-3-1 kv-cache: hit_rate=0.68 mem_rss=4.4GB
```
Omar M: ok that suggests eviction thrash. quick mitigation: bump cache window to 4s and revert eviction-policy change in pool-3 config. I can do the revert and watch for 10m.
Kevin L: pushed a rollback PR for the eviction-policy tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4521 — reverting commit 9f3a2c. will run canary on pool-3-0 only first. looks like the quantization kernel change increased working set on long sequences.
Sam P: I'll own follow-ups and create a ticket with logs + perf graphs: INF-2317. tagging @Kevin and @Omar. plan: (1) stabilize -> watch 30m, (2) run longer replay on staging with long sequences, (3) consider quantization profile tweak.
Rachel S: thanks team — if revert looks good in 10m, i'll mark the alert as resolved and handoff to Sam. otherwise i'll escalate to oncall. leaving detailed steps in the shift notes.
Omar M: on it, watching logs. will update here when canary completes.
Kevin L: canary rolled to pool-3-0 at +2m, no further p50 spikes so far. :thumbsup:
sre-bot: ALERT RESOLVED: /generate eu-west high_latency — last observed 07:18 UTC. incident ticket INF-2317 created and linked.
Sam P: got it, taking INF-2317. will post follow-up with perf replay results by EOD. cheers.
